completion:
Write or print (not type) the following text on the TEST RECORD, in black or blue ink, in the TRANSPORT column:
   **ELECTRICAL FAILURE**
3. If a medical safety officer is also available to document the failure, they may do so using the required language of "Electrical Equipment Failure - Cert if Removed". If a medical safety officer with this role is not available, then the above 3 steps can be followed instead.
